data.name: Kieran
data.gender_notes: Kieran is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Irish name Ciarán, meaning 'dark', 'handsome' or 'black haired'. In Irish mythology, Ciarán was a 6th-century Irish monk and patron saint of the city of Cork. The name Kieran carries the meaning “Dark, Handsome” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Kieran usually hope their child will grow to embody dark, handsome and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes inner strength, resilience, and the journey towards enlightenment.
data.etymology: Kieran belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Dark, Handsome.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kieran total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_hebrew.name: קירן
in_hebrew.meaning: קירן הוא שם שפירושו נוער או שחרור
in_hebrew.long_meaning: קירן הוא שם עברי שמקורו בקירן, שמשמעותו היא נוער או שחרור. השם קירן קשור למושג של התחדשות ותחילת דרך חדשה. השם נמצא בשימוש בעיקר בקהילות נוצריות וקתוליות, ויש לו קונוטציה רוחנית של הולדת מחדש וחדשנות.

in_greek.name: Κίεραν
in_greek.meaning: Το Κίεραν σημαίνει νεαρός ή ελευθερία
in_greek.long_meaning: Το Κίεραν είναι όνομα που προέρχεται από την ιρλανδική γλώσσα και σημαίνει νεαρός ή ελευθερία. Στην παράδοση της Εκκλησίας, το όνομα Κίεραν συνδέεται με την έννοια της ανανέωσης και της πνευματικής αναγέννησης. Το όνομα έχει χρησιμοποιηθεί ιστορικά στην Ιρλανδία και σε άλλες αγγλοσαξονικές χώρες.

in_latin.name: Kieran
in_latin.meaning: Kieran means young or freed one
in_latin.long_meaning: Kieran is a name derived from Irish roots, signifying youth or liberation. In Christian tradition, the name Kieran connotes spiritual rebirth and renewal. Historically, the name has been used in Ireland and other English-speaking countries, reflecting its Celtic origins.

in_english.name: Kieran
in_english.meaning: Kieran means little dark one or young lord
in_english.long_meaning: Kieran is a Christian name of Irish origin, meaning 'little dark one' or 'young lord'. Etymologically, it is derived from the Gaelic name 'Ciarán', which is rooted in the word 'ciar', meaning 'dark' or 'black', and the diminutive suffix '-án'. The name Kieran has been associated with Saint Ciaran, an Irish monk and abbot who lived in the 6th century. In Christian tradition, the name Kieran symbolizes humility, modesty, and spiritual growth. Historically, the name has been popularized in Ireland and among English-speaking Christians.

data.cultural_impact: The name Kieran has been popular in the English-speaking world due to its Irish roots and beautiful meaning. It carries a sense of mystery, elegance, and a connection to the rich history of the Irish people. Kieran is a distinctive,not-too-common name that appeals to those looking for something unique yet meaningful. It is also a popular choice in the United States, Canada, Australia and New Zealand, reflecting the influence of Irish heritage in these countries.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Kieran holds deep spiritual significance for those with Irish heritage or for those who resonate with its meaning. As a monk and patron saint, Ciarán embodies the qualities of a spiritual leader. He represents the pursuit of knowledge, inner peace, and the deep connection between the individual and God. As a name, Kieran is a reminder of the importance of spiritual growth and the transformative power of the spiritual journey. Whether one is of Irish descent or simply drawn to the name, Kieran offers a meaningful connection to the past and an inspiring vision for the future.​
data.spiritual_symbolism: Kieran: Dark-haired, dark-skinned, or handsome chief. A name rooted in ancient Celtic traditions, evoking images of strong, wise, and courageous leaders. Symbolically, it represents the inner strength and resilience of the soul in its journey through life.

historical_references.reference: St. Kieran of Clonmacnoise was the founder of the famous monastic settlement at Clonmacnoise, County Offaly, Ireland, in the 6th century.
St. Kieran of Seir Kieran (or Kilkea) in County Carlow, Ireland, was a 6th-century bishop and one of the Twelve Apostles of Ireland. He is said to have been a student of St. Finnian of Clonard.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Kieran, of Irish origin, has gained popularity in modern times due to its unique sound and rich cultural heritage. It is now a common name among individuals who identify with their Irish roots, and is often used in contexts related to Irish history and culture. In the technology sector, Kieran is seen as a modern and innovative name, reflecting the forward-thinking and creative nature of those who bear it. On social media platforms such as LinkedIn, Twitter, and Instagram, Kieran is used as a username or display name by individuals who want to convey a sense of individuality, authenticity, and connection to their heritage. Overall, Kieran is a name that embodies a modern, forward-thinking, and culturally rich identity.
